# Municipal Ordinance (Kautusang Bayan) No. 002, Series of 2013

**Isang Kapasiyahang Nagpapatibay na ang Dating Fabrica Street na Natatayo sa Larangang Paaralan, Paaralang Pampublikong Elementarya at Mataas na Paaralan ng Bayan ng Pitogo sa Barangay Dulowang Bayan ay Kilalanin Bilang Diego Silang Street**

Kapasiyahan 037

## Summary

Renames "Dating Fabrica Street" to "[[Diego Silang]] Street" in [[Barangay Dulowang Bayan]], [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The street is located in the school zone area near the public elementary and high school of Pitogo.

Note: Presiding Officer for this session is [[Rodante V. Cortes]] (Vice Mayor). SB membership includes [[Cristina D. Esconia]].

## Key Provisions

- **Street Renaming:** The former Fabrica Street in Barangay Dulowang Bayan is officially renamed to Diego Silang Street
- **Location:** Near the public elementary school and high school of the municipality
- **Historical Reference:** Named after Diego Silang, Filipino revolutionary leader
